snippet.title: [C64] Hacker
snippet.description:
Hacker by Activision

It is 1985 and a big corporation is trying to harness the heat of the Earth's core to produce energy...  or destroy a whole continent while trying it.

With our trusty C64, we've hacked into their systems and try to dig up information to stop them.

Broadcasted live on Twitch -- Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/dxmaniac
